Radius of Curvature for Polar Curves explained with formula derivation and solved examples for B.Sc. Maths, Engineering Mathematics, Calculus & IIT JAM. Learn step-by-step polar curve curvature.

Radius of Curvature for Polar Curves explained with formula derivation and solved examples for B.Sc. Maths, Engineering Mathematics, Calculus & IIT JAM. Learn step-by-step polar curve curvature.

Is video lecture mein hum discuss karenge Radius of Curvature for Polar Curves (ध्रुवीय वक्रों के लिए वक्रता त्रिज्या). Hum step-by-step standard formula ka derivation karenge aur important illustrative problems solve karenge jo university exams aur competitive exams ke liye bohot zaroori hain.

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Parametric Curvature
01:33 - Polar Coordinates & Geometry Review (r, θ, φ, ψ)
02:45 - Complete Derivation of Radius of Curvature Formula for Polar Curves
10:44 - Standard Formula (ρ) in Polar Coordinates
13:45 - Example 1: Curve r^n = a^n cos(nθ) Proof
21:16 - Example 2: Cardioid r = a(1 + cos θ) & Chord through Pole
30:30 - Example 3: Equiangular Spiral r = a e^(θ cot α)
43:08 - Newton's Method for Polar Curves at the Pole (Cardioid Example)
48:00 - Summary & Next Lecture Overview

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein, apne friends ke saath Share karein aur channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
